title: p3-rename-v2
purpose: Storage probe E2 (v2): a declared `renamedFrom` must MOVE the data, not drop and recreate the column. renamedFrom is a documented user-facing feature, so it has to mean the same thing on every engine or the docs are wrong for some users.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo -- it serves conformance vector E2 and nothing else.
Built by the storage conformance Tier C tests; not intended to be run by hand.

The manifest id is deliberately SHARED with the sibling version: v1 and v2 are two versions of ONE app, and NPDev keys an app's identity -- including the directory a file-backed H2 database lives in -- on this id. Two different ids made the two versions resolve to two different H2 files, so the probe reported "0 rows survived" on h2local while measuring nothing at all. Server engines never showed it, because there the database name is the whole address.
expectedOutcomes: Values written to `isbn` under v1 are readable as `isbn13` under v2.
No row is lost and no value is blanked.
